info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v5-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Decline Management API allows users to efficiently manage the decline decisions for credit card applications. It provides functionality to remove declined applications from the system, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records. This API is typically utilized by financial institutions and application processing systems that handle credit card requests. By streamlining the decline management process, it supports better decision-making and compliance with operational guidelines.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to decline an application, which will mark it as not approved. Use this operation when an application does not meet the required criteria or when it is no longer considered.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to decline an application. It contains the necessary parameters to specify the reason for declining and any other relevant information required by the system. Make sure to provide all required fields as per the schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the application has been declined.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: Request body for declining an application operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the decline operation.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result generated by this operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.description: The response schema for the successful decline operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information related to the decline operation.
